notes: No SEC filings. All figures come from BYD's 2024 annual results announcement on HKEXnews (24 March 2025), which states that it contains 'the full text of the 2024 Annual Report'. The report is bilingual and prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, in RMB'000 (ISO CNY). OWNERSHIP is as at 31 December 2024 from the SFO Part XV registers. The report gives Wang Chuan-fu's A-share and H-share holdings separately as 17.65% and 0.03% of total issued share capital, so leader.derived combines them (17.69%); pctEconomic is null because no single total is stated. The 3,727,700 A shares he holds through the E Fund BYD No.1 asset management plan are excluded, as in the report's own figure. No family total is disclosed. Xia Zuo-quan also holds 500,000 H shares (0.02%) not included in his 2.84%. Citigroup's 2.32% H-share long position (mostly a 2.13% lending pool) is not listed. HKSCC Nominees is not used. A 129,800,000 H-share placing in March 2025 diluted all holders after the period. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Cash payments for distribution of dividends, profits or interest expenses' (RMB 10,051,081k) mixes dividends, interest and RMB 415,066k paid to minority shareholders, so it is not used. The figure is the retained-profits note line for cash dividends on ordinary shares in 2024 (RMB 9,012,493k; Chinese text 支付普通股現金股利, 'ordinary share cash dividends paid'); the equity statement shows the same 9,012,493 as 'Distribution to shareholders'. It is a note figure, not a cash-flow line. BUYBACKS: RMB 400,028k of A shares repurchased and cancelled. This excludes RMB 2,863,844k 'Repurchase right on Shareholders' investment', which Note V.36 (other non-current liabilities) describes as BYD's obligation to repurchase equity in its subsidiary BYD Semiconductor from strategic investors, not a repurchase of BYD's own shares. STOCK COMP: equity-settled share-based payment expense for the year (RMB 400,404k).
